explains.en: This small flying insect visits flowers to gather food. It collects pollen and sweet liquid called nectar. Some kinds make honey.
Its body is often covered with tiny hairs. These hairs carry pollen from flower to flower. This helps many plants make seeds.
Some kinds live in large groups while others live alone. A group may build a home with many small cells. Many kinds can sting to defend themselves.

examples.en: Honey bees fly from flower to flower collecting nectar.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂在花叢間穿梭採集花蜜。

examples.en: Be careful not to disturb the beehive or bees might sting you.
examples.zh: 小心不要驚擾蜂窩，否則蜜蜂可能會蜇你。

examples.en: He has been a busy bee all morning cleaning every room.
examples.zh: 他整個早上就像隻勤勞的小蜜蜂一樣打掃每間房間。

explains.en: This is a small vehicle that travels on water. People may use it for fishing or crossing a lake. It can move with a motor, oars, or sails.
People ride in this watercraft on rivers, lakes, or the sea. It may carry a few people or many. A person can guide it with oars or a motor.
This word names a craft that floats on water. Some are small enough for one family. Others carry people or goods from place to place.

examples.en: We took a boat tour around Sun Moon Lake.
examples.zh: 我們搭船遊覽日月潭。

examples.en: The fishermen returned to port with their small wooden boats.
examples.zh: 漁夫們划著他們的小木船返回港口。

examples.en: A rowing boat is available for rent in the park.
examples.zh: 公園裡有提供划艇租借。

explains.en: This is a sweet baked food. It may be made for a birthday or other special day. People often cut it into slices.
A baker mixes flour, eggs, and sugar to make this treat. It may have cream or fruit on top. Families often share it at parties.
This word names a soft sweet food from an oven. It may be round or square. A person can add frosting to its top.

examples.en: We bought a chocolate birthday cake for Lucy.
examples.zh: 我們為露西買了一個巧克力生日蛋糕。

examples.en: Solving this basic algebra problem is a piece of cake for him.
examples.zh: 解開這道基礎代數題目對他來說簡直易如反掌。

examples.en: She decorated the strawberry shortcake with whipped cream and fresh mint leaves.
examples.zh: 她用鮮奶油與新鮮薄荷葉點綴草莓蛋糕。

explains.en: This is a warm piece of clothing worn over other clothes. It usually has sleeves and opens at the front. As a verb, it can mean covering something with a layer.
People wear this garment outdoors when the weather is cool. It may have buttons or a zipper. A layer of paint can also cover an object.
This word names an outer garment that covers the upper body. It may be long or short. As a verb, it means putting a layer around something.

examples.en: Put on a warm coat; it is chilly outside.
examples.zh: 穿上一件保暖大衣，外面很涼。

examples.en: Hang your winter coat on the rack by the entrance.
examples.zh: 把你的冬天大衣掛在玄關旁的衣架上。

examples.en: The doctor put on his white laboratory coat.
examples.zh: 醫生穿上了他的白色實驗大衣。

explains.en: It describes something small and pleasant to look at. A kitten or puppy may seem this way. People may smile when they see it.
Use this word for a person, animal, or thing that looks sweet. A baby animal may make people feel happy. It can also describe a charming style.
This word tells that something looks charming or lovable. It may describe a tiny toy. A friendly face may seem this way.

examples.en: Look at that cute little stray kitten!
examples.zh: 快看那隻可愛的小流浪貓！

examples.en: She bought a pair of cute cartoon socks yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天買了一雙可愛的卡通襪子。

examples.en: The baby made a cute face whenever hearing sweet music.
examples.zh: 寶寶每當聽到悅耳音樂時都會擺出可愛表情。

explains.en: This is the time from one midnight to the next. It can also mean the light part of that time. People use it when talking about a date or a period of time.
A calendar has many of these units. The sun shines during its bright part. People may remember a special one each year.
This word names a unit of time with twenty-four hours. It may also mean the time when the sun is up. People count them on a calendar.

examples.en: Have a nice day!
examples.zh: 祝你有美好的一天！

examples.en: I practice playing the violin for an hour every day.
examples.zh: 我每天練習拉小提琴一個小時。

examples.en: Sunday is my favorite day of the week.
examples.zh: 星期日是我一週中最喜歡的一天。

explains.en: This is a story or picture in the mind during sleep. It can also mean a strong hope for the future. People may talk about what they want to do one day.
A person may see this while sleeping. The word can also describe a goal someone hopes to reach. A child may hope to travel around the world.
This word names images in the mind at night. It may also mean a wish for the future. People may work hard to make one come true.

examples.en: Follow your dream and never give up easily.
examples.zh: 追隨你的夢想，絕不要輕言放棄。

examples.en: I had a strange and vivid dream about flying across towering mountain ranges.
examples.zh: 我做了一個奇特且栩栩如生的夢，夢見自己在高聳的山脈上空翱翔。

examples.en: She dreams of traveling around the globe after completing her degree.
examples.zh: 她夢想著在取得學位後能踏上環遊世界的旅程。

explains.en: It means giving food to someone or an animal. A parent may serve a meal to a child. It can also name a stream of new posts online.
Use this word when placing food before someone. A person may give seeds to birds. It can also mean a flow of updates on a phone or site.
This verb means providing food. It can describe a parent helping a child eat. The noun may name a stream of messages.

examples.en: Scroll down your news feed to discover trending stories and friends' updates.
examples.zh: 向下滑動你的社群動態牆以探索熱門話題與好友最新動態。

examples.en: Farmers wake up at dawn to feed livestock in the barn.
examples.zh: 農夫們黎明時分就早早起床到牲口棚舍裡餵食牲畜家禽。

examples.en: The RSS feed automatically pulls fresh news articles into the reader app.
examples.zh: RSS 資訊摘要源能自動將最新出版的新聞文章抓取至閱讀器中。

explains.en: This is an activity with rules that people play. It can also mean a contest between teams. Players try to reach a goal or score points.
People may use cards, balls, or boards for this activity. It often has winners and losers. A school may hold a contest between teams.
This word names something people play for fun. It can be done alone or with others. It may also mean a match or contest.

examples.en: Let's play a board game together tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚我們一起玩桌遊吧。

examples.en: Our school basketball team won the championship game yesterday.
examples.zh: 我們學校籃球隊昨天贏得了冠軍賽。

examples.en: Playing puzzle games can stimulate your brain and logical thinking.
examples.zh: 玩益智遊戲能刺激大腦思考與邏輯能力。

explains.en: It means becoming larger or older over time. A seed may turn into a plant. A gardener can raise vegetables.
Use this word when a living thing gets bigger. A child changes as years pass. It can also mean planting and caring for crops.
This verb tells that something develops over time. A plant may become tall. A farmer may raise food for people.

examples.en: Sunflowers grow quickly in sunny weather.
examples.zh: 向日葵在陽光普照的天氣裡生長迅速。

examples.en: Organic farmers grow luscious strawberries without artificial chemical pesticides.
examples.zh: 有機農民不使用人工化學農藥培育鮮美多汁的草莓。

examples.en: Demand for eco-friendly electric vehicles continues to grow worldwide.
examples.zh: 全球對環保電動車的需求持續強勁增長。

explains.en: This is warmth that comes from a fire, sun, or stove. It can also mean making something warm. A person may feel it on a sunny day.
Use this word for high temperature. A cook may apply it to food. It can also mean passion or strong feelings.
This word names warmth or a high temperature. The sun gives it to the land. As a verb, it means making something warmer.

examples.en: The heat from the sun warmed the garden.
examples.zh: 太陽的熱能讓花園暖和起來。

examples.en: Please heat the soup before lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐前請把湯加熱。

examples.en: The heat made the room uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 熱氣讓房間變得不舒服。

entries.definition: （形）高的；高級的；（副）高高地；（名）高點

explains.en: It means far above the ground or at a great level. A bird may sit on a tall tree. The word can also describe a large amount or position.
Use this word for something near the top. A plane travels well above buildings. It may describe a number or sound that is strong.
This word points to a place far from the ground. It can describe a tall mountain. A score may be greater than most others.

examples.en: The kite flew high above the houses.
examples.zh: 風箏飛得比房子高。

examples.en: The mountain is very high.
examples.zh: 這座山非常高。

examples.en: She heard a high sound from the bird.
examples.zh: 她聽見鳥兒發出高音。

explains.en: It means keeping something out of sight. A child may put a toy under a bed. A person may also keep feelings private.
Use this word when placing an object where others cannot see it. Someone may stay behind a tree during a game. It can also mean not showing the truth.
This verb means making something hard to see. A person may cover an object. It can also describe keeping a feeling private.

examples.en: The children hide behind the tree.
examples.zh: 孩子們躲在樹後面。

examples.en: She hid the gift in a drawer.
examples.zh: 她把禮物藏在抽屜裡。

examples.en: He tried to hide his surprise.
examples.zh: 他試著藏起自己的驚訝。

entries.definition: 希望；期盼；綠色希望之光點亮島嶼永續光明未來；為末期癌症患者與家庭重新點燃生命希望

explains.en: It means wishing for something good to happen. A person may look forward to a better day. As a noun, it can name that wish.
Use this word for a positive wish about the future. A student may want to do well on a test. The feeling can help someone keep trying.
This word can mean expecting a good result. It may name a wish for the future. People may talk about it when times are hard.

examples.en: I hope you have a wonderful weekend!
examples.zh: 希望你有個美好的週末！

examples.en: We hope that tomorrow will be sunny for our school field trip.
examples.zh: 我們希望明天校外教學是個大晴天。

examples.en: Never lose hope even when facing challenging circumstances.
examples.zh: 即使面對具挑戰性的處境，也絕不要失去希望。

examples.en: I hope to see you again during the winter vacation!
examples.zh: 希望寒假能再次見到你！

examples.en: We hope for good weather so we can go camping this weekend.
examples.zh: 我們期盼好天氣，這樣週末才能去露營。

examples.en: Never lose hope, even when facing difficult times.
examples.zh: 即使面對艱難困境，也絕不要失去希望。

examples.en: The spinning ocean turbines stand tall on the horizon, shining as a glorious beacon of sustainable green hope.
examples.zh: 矗立於海天交界處旋轉不息的風機，宛如守護這座美麗島嶼的燈塔，綻放出點亮永續未來的綠色希望之光。

examples.en: Every blade rotating against the wind whispers a message of renewable hope for a greener planet.
examples.zh: 每一支在大洋季風中昂然旋轉的巨大葉片，皆在藍天碧海間向世人傳遞著拯救地球暖化的無限綠色希望。

examples.en: Generations of environmental advocates look out at the offshore wind farm with hearts brimming with hope.
examples.zh: 世代為環境保護奔走奉獻的文史與環保志士佇立在海堤邊遠眺壯闊風場，內心深處被美好的希望所溫暖。

examples.en: Innovative cell therapies restore renewed hope to courageous patients battling terminal diagnoses.
examples.zh: 創新的活體細胞療法，為勇敢對抗末期絕症的無數病患與家庭重新點燃了「重獲新生的生命希望」（Hope）。

examples.en: We hope that tomorrow's sunny weather will allow the coastal festival to proceed without delay.
examples.zh: 我們衷心期盼明天會是個晴空萬里的好天氣，讓期待已久的海濱音樂藝術季能順暢如期舉行。

examples.en: The birth of newborn giant panda twins brought infectious joy and renewed hope to conservationists worldwide.
examples.zh: 新生大貓熊雙胞胎幼崽的平安誕生，為全球奮戰在一線的大熊貓保育志工帶來了無比喜悅與希望之光。

explains.en: This is a large area of water surrounded by land. It may be deep or shallow. Fish and plants live there.
People may swim or boat on this body of water. It is not as large as the sea. A river may flow into one.
This word names water held within land. It may be natural or made by people. Ducks often swim on it.

examples.en: Sun Moon Lake is a famous scenic spot in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 日月潭是台灣著名的觀光景點。

examples.en: We rented a paddle boat and glided peacefully across the quiet lake.
examples.zh: 我們租了一艘腳踏船，在寧靜的湖面上悠閒泛舟。

examples.en: Mist covered the surface of the mountain lake at dawn.
examples.zh: 清晨拂曉時分，薄霧輕籠著高山湖泊的湖面。

entries.definition: 光線；燈；明亮的；點燃；輕的；淺色的；輕盈的；鑑識科學之光驅散黑暗照亮司法正義

explains.en: This is what lets people see in a dark room. It may also name a lamp or a pale shade. As a verb, it can mean setting something on fire.
Use this word for brightness from the sun or a bulb. It can describe something that does not weigh much. A match may help a person start a flame.
This word may mean brightness or a source of brightness. It can describe a pale color or a small weight. As an action, it means making a flame start.

examples.en: Please turn off the lights when you leave.
examples.zh: 離開時請隨手關燈。

examples.en: The morning sunlight illuminated the entire classroom.
examples.zh: 晨曦的陽光照亮了整間教室。

examples.en: Pack a light backpack when going on a day hike.
examples.zh: 一日健行出發時，請準備輕便的隨身背包。

examples.en: Carry a light jacket in case the weather turns cool.
examples.zh: 帶件薄夾克以防天氣轉涼。

examples.en: She prefers a light breakfast like yogurt and sliced fruit.
examples.zh: 她偏好清淡簡單的早餐，例如優格和切片水果。

examples.en: This aluminum laptop is exceptionally light and portable.
examples.zh: 這款鋁合金筆記型電腦格外輕巧便攜。

examples.en: Aluminum is a durable and very light metal.
examples.zh: 鋁是一種耐用且非常輕盈的金屬。

examples.en: Sunlight streamed through the bedroom window, illuminating the wooden desk.
examples.zh: 陽光透過臥室窗戶灑落進來，照亮了質樸的木製書桌。

examples.en: Pack light when traveling so you can walk comfortably between city transit lines.
examples.zh: 旅行時請輕裝簡行，這樣在城市各交通轉運路線之間移動才會輕鬆自如。

examples.en: Forensic science shines an unwavering light into the darkest shadows of crime, bringing hidden facts into the open.
examples.zh: 鑑識科學宛如一柄永不熄滅的正義之光，穿透罪惡最深沉的黑暗陰影，讓真相大白於天下。

examples.en: Each recovered fingerprint and DNA match serves as a beacon of light piercing through criminal deception.
examples.zh: 每一枚被顯影比對出的指紋與每一次 DNA 吻合，皆如刺破犯罪謊言與偽裝欺騙的璀璨希望之光。

examples.en: The relentless search for evidence ensures that the light of truth prevails over the cover-ups of corruption.
examples.zh: 對物證永不停歇的客觀鑑識與追尋，確保了真理正義之光終將徹底驅散官商勾結與毀屍滅證的暗黑陰霾。

explains.en: It means enjoying or preferring something. It can also compare two things that are similar. A small symbol may show that someone approves of a post.
Use this word to say what someone enjoys. It may show that two things are similar. Online, it can mean pressing a symbol to show approval.
This word can name a preference. It may also mean similar to another thing. The noun can be an approval mark on a website.

examples.en: I like milk tea with less sugar and no ice.
examples.zh: 我喜歡微糖去冰的奶茶。

examples.en: He looks just like his father when he smiles.
examples.zh: 他微笑時看起來就像他父親一樣。

examples.en: What would you like to have for dinner tonight?
examples.zh: 你今晚晚餐想吃點什麼呢？

examples.en: Don't forget to hit like and subscribe to our channel!
examples.zh: 別忘了按讚並訂閱我們的頻道！

examples.en: Her latest travel photo album garnered thousands of likes within an hour.
examples.zh: 她最新的旅行相簿在一小時內就收穫了數千個讚。

examples.en: Like his father, he has a profound passion for classical literature.
examples.zh: 就像他的父親一樣，他對古典文學懷抱著無比深沉的熱情。

entries.definition: （形）低的；矮的；低落的；（副）低低地；（名）低點；低音

explains.en: It describes a position near the bottom. A quiet sound may have little volume. It can also name a deep tone.
Use this word for something not high. A shelf may sit near the floor. A person may speak softly with a gentle voice.
This word can mean not high in place or amount. A soft voice may have this quality. It can also describe a small price.

examples.en: The shelf is too low for the tall books.
examples.zh: 這個架子對高書來說太低了。

examples.en: The plane flew low over the sea.
examples.zh: 飛機低低地飛過海面。

examples.en: The store sells low-cost school supplies.
examples.zh: 這家商店販售低價的學用品。

explains.en: It means producing or building something. A person may use wood to form a chair. It can also mean causing a feeling or result.
Use this verb when someone brings a new thing into being. A cook may prepare a meal. A choice may cause a result.
This word means forming something from parts. It may describe preparing food or goods. It can also mean causing an effect.

examples.en: Let's make a cup of hot chocolate.
examples.zh: 我們來泡一杯熱巧克力吧。

examples.en: Please make sure that all the classroom windows are closed.
examples.zh: 請務必確認教室的所有窗戶都已關妥。

examples.en: Joining after-school clubs is a fantastic way to make new friends.
examples.zh: 參加課後社團是結交新朋友的絕佳途徑。

explains.en: This is food from the bodies of animals. People may cook it with vegetables. Chicken and beef are kinds.
Many people eat this food as a source of protein. It may be roasted or fried. A vegetarian chooses foods without it.
This word names the flesh of an animal used as food. It may come from a cow, pig, or bird. A cook prepares it before serving.

examples.en: Vegetarians do not eat meat.
examples.zh: 素食者不吃肉類。

examples.en: Keep the raw meat in the freezer until you are ready to cook.
examples.zh: 在準備烹煮之前，請將生肉保存在冷凍庫。

examples.en: Eating too much red meat may not be good for health.
examples.zh: 吃太多紅肉可能對健康無益。

explains.en: This is the word used to identify a person or thing. It may be written on a card. As a verb, it means giving someone or something a label.
People use this word when introducing themselves. A label may show who an object belongs to. The verb means saying what someone is called.
This word can mean a personal label. It helps people know who someone is. As an action, it means choosing a title for a person or object.

examples.en: What is your name?
examples.zh: 你的名字是什麼？

examples.en: Please write your name clearly on the test sheet.
examples.zh: 請在試卷上清楚寫下你的名字。

examples.en: They named their newborn daughter Emily.
examples.zh: 他們把剛出生的女兒命名為艾蜜莉。

explains.en: It means something is required or wanted. A person may ask for water after running. As a noun, it can name an important requirement.
Use this word when someone must have something. Food and rest are basic requirements. A person may ask for help.
This word tells that something is necessary. It can describe a want or a duty. As a noun, it names something important to have.

examples.en: You need to practice speaking English every day.
examples.zh: 你需要每天練習開口說英語。

examples.en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
examples.zh: 患難見真情。

examples.en: We need three more chairs for the guests in the living room.
examples.zh: 我們客廳裡還需要三張椅子給客人坐。

explains.en: This is the dark part of the day after evening. People usually sleep then. Stars may be visible in the sky.
The sun is below the horizon during this time. A person may turn on a light to read. Some animals are active then.
This word names the time from sunset to sunrise. It can be quiet or busy. People often rest during it.

examples.en: Don't stay up late at night.
examples.zh: 晚上不要熬夜。

examples.en: The stars look exceptionally bright in the night sky.
examples.zh: 夜空中的星星看起來格外明亮。

examples.en: Good night, have sweet dreams!
examples.zh: 晚安，祝你有個好夢！

explains.en: Children may do this with toys or games for fun. Musicians do it with songs and instruments. The word can also mean a show in a theater.
A child can move around for fun with friends. A band may make music for an audience. A story acted on stage can also have this name.
This action can mean having fun with a game. A musician may make notes on an instrument. A theater may show a story with actors.

examples.en: We often play basketball on Friday afternoons.
examples.zh: 我們經常在週五下午打籃球。

examples.en: She plays the piano with great skill and emotion.
examples.zh: 她彈鋼琴技巧純熟且充滿情感。

examples.en: Our school drama club will put on a Shakespeare play next month.
examples.zh: 我們學校話劇社下個月將上演莎士比亞戲劇。

explains.en: Water falls from clouds onto the ground. People carry umbrellas to stay dry. This word can also mean water coming down in drops.
Dark clouds may bring drops of water. A wet day can make roads shiny. Farmers need this water for crops.
This is water that falls from the sky. A roof may make a tapping sound when drops hit it. People may wait inside during a heavy shower.

examples.en: It started to rain in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 下午開始下雨了。

examples.en: Heavy rain caused flash flooding on some low-lying streets.
examples.zh: 豪大雨導致部分低窪街道發生積水。

examples.en: Plants grow quickly after receiving fresh spring rain.
examples.zh: 植物在接受了春雨滋潤後迅速生長。

explains.en: It means sitting on an animal or bicycle and moving along. A person may travel in a car or bus. The same word can name a short trip.
A child may travel on a horse. A family can go in a car to town. This word may also mean a journey in a vehicle.
A person can sit on a bike and travel. People may go in a bus together. The action can also describe moving on a horse.

examples.en: Children love to ride bikes in the yard.
examples.zh: 小朋友們喜歡在院子裡騎腳踏車。

examples.en: Can you give me a ride to the train station tomorrow?
examples.zh: 你明天可以順路載我一程去火車站嗎？

examples.en: He learned how to ride a horse during summer camp.
examples.zh: 他在夏令營期間學會了騎馬。

entries.definition: 右邊的；正確的；權利；向右；右邊

explains.en: It can mean the side opposite the left. It may also describe an answer that is correct. A person can have a freedom to do something.
A hand on one side is often used for writing. A good answer is not wrong. The word can also name something a person is allowed to do.
This word can describe a true answer. It can mean the direction opposite left. A law may protect a freedom people have.

examples.en: The post office is on your right.
examples.zh: 郵局就在你的右手邊。

examples.en: You got all the answers right on today's vocabulary quiz.
examples.zh: 你在今天的單字小考中答對了所有題目。

examples.en: Everyone has the right to receive a good quality education.
examples.zh: 人人都有享有優質教育的權利。

examples.en: You gave the right answer to that question!
examples.zh: 你回答了那個問題的正確答案！

examples.en: Turn right at the convenience store to reach the train station.
examples.zh: 在便利商店處向右轉即可抵達火車站。

examples.en: Everyone has the fundamental human right to receive free education.
examples.zh: 每個人都享有接受基本免費教育的人權權利。

examples.en: Every child has the basic human right to receive free education.
examples.zh: 每個孩童都享有接受免費教育的基本人權權利。

examples.en: Double-check your calculation to ensure you have the right total answer.
examples.zh: 請再次仔細核算確認算式，以確保你計算出的最終總額答案完全正確。

examples.en: Turn right at the convenience store and walk straight for two blocks.
examples.zh: 在那家便利商店路口右轉，接著筆直向前步行兩個街區即達。

explains.en: It is a thick cord made from twisted strands. People tie things with it. A climber may use one for safety.
This long strong cord can hold a boat. A person can tie a knot in it. Workers may use it to lift something heavy.
Many thin strands are twisted together to make this. It may help pull a bucket from a well. A sailor uses it to secure a boat.

examples.en: The sailor tied the rope to the boat.
examples.zh: 水手把繩子綁在船上。

examples.en: We used a strong rope to pull the box.
examples.zh: 我們用一條堅固的繩子拉箱子。

examples.en: The climber held the rope tightly.
examples.zh: 攀岩者緊緊握著繩子。

explains.en: It means not different. Two shirts may look alike in color and shape. One person can be compared with another using this word.
Use this word when two things match. Twins may wear matching hats. It can mean one exact item or person.
This word describes things that are alike. A pair of shoes may have a matching look. It can also mean unchanged.

examples.en: We go to the same junior high school.
examples.zh: 我們就讀同一所國中。

examples.en: The two identical twins wear the exact same bright yellow shirts.
examples.zh: 這對雙胞胎兄弟穿著完全一模一樣的亮黃色上衣。

examples.en: Although it was raining, they went hiking all the same.
examples.zh: 儘管下著雨，他們依然照樣去登山健行。

explains.en: It means using words to share an idea aloud. A person may tell the truth. The word can also mean giving an opinion.
A child may tell what happened at school. A teacher can speak a sentence. Someone may give their view about a book.
This action uses the voice to share thoughts. A person may repeat a phrase. It can also mean naming or stating something.

examples.en: What did the teacher say about the test?
examples.zh: 老師說了什麼關於考試的事？

examples.en: Remember to say thank you whenever someone assists you.
examples.zh: 每當有人協助你時，記得說聲謝謝。

examples.en: It goes without saying that health is more valuable than money.
examples.zh: 不用說，健康自然比金錢更加珍貴。

explains.en: People sit on this object in a room. A bus has many of them. As a verb, it can mean helping someone sit down.
A chair has a place for one person. A theater may have many in lines. A host may help a guest sit.
This object may be found at a table. A person can sit in it. It can also mean giving someone a place to sit.

examples.en: Please fasten your seatbelt and take your seat.
examples.zh: 請繫妥安全帶並在座位就座。

examples.en: She kindly gave up her subway seat to an elderly pregnant woman.
examples.zh: 她親切地將捷運座位讓給了一位年邁的孕婦。

examples.en: You can reserve your cinema seat online to get the best viewing angle.
examples.zh: 你可以事先在網路上劃位電影院座位以獲取最佳觀影視角。

explains.en: It means using the eyes to notice something. A person may look at a bird in a tree. It can also mean understanding an idea.
A child may look at a picture. Someone can visit a friend. The word may mean knowing what a speaker means.
This action uses the eyes. A person may meet a doctor. It can also mean understanding a fact.

examples.en: I see what you mean.
examples.zh: 我明白你的意思了。

examples.en: Let me see the test results before we celebrate.
examples.zh: 在我們慶祝之前，先讓我看一下考試成果。

examples.en: It was so foggy that we could hardly see the road ahead.
examples.zh: 霧太濃了，以致於我們幾乎看不見前方的道路。

explains.en: A small part of a fruit can grow into a new plant. Birds may eat them. A farmer may put them in soil.
This tiny part can grow into a tree or flower. It is often found inside fruit. People plant it in the ground to grow food.
A plant begins life from this small object. It may be carried by wind or animals. A gardener puts it in soil and adds water.

examples.en: The farmer planted a seed in the soil.
examples.zh: 農夫在土裡種下一顆種子。

examples.en: A tiny seed grew into a tall sunflower.
examples.zh: 一顆小種子長成了一株高高的向日葵。

examples.en: The bird carried a seed in its beak.
examples.zh: 那隻鳥用喙叼著一顆種子。

explains.en: It means moving without much speed. A turtle may cross a path this way. A person may take time to finish work.
A bus may travel at a low speed. A tired person may walk this way. It can also describe a clock that seems to move with difficulty.
This word means not fast. A person may speak with long pauses. A river may flow gently.

examples.en: Turtles are famous for their slow pace.
examples.zh: 烏龜以緩慢的步伐聞名。

examples.en: Drivers must slow down when approaching a pedestrian crosswalk.
examples.zh: 駕駛人在接近行人穿越道時必須減速。

examples.en: The movie scene was captured in artistic slow motion.
examples.zh: 電影場景以極富藝術感的慢動作鏡頭呈現。

entries.definition: 雪；下雪；海雪 (表層有機碎屑如雪花般緩緩沉降)

explains.en: Soft white flakes fall from clouds in cold weather. Children may build a person-shaped figure outside. It can cover roads and trees.
This frozen water falls from the sky. It makes hills white in winter. People wear warm coats when it comes.
A mountain may have this white covering. Each flake has a special pattern. A warm hand can make it melt.

examples.en: It rarely snows in low altitude areas of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台灣低海拔地區很少下雪。

examples.en: Mount Hehuan is covered in thick snow during cold winters.
examples.zh: 寒冷的冬日裡，合歡山覆蓋著厚厚的白雪。

examples.en: Children were delighted to build a snowman in the fresh snow.
examples.zh: 小朋友們在新下的白雪中開心地堆起雪人。

examples.en: Drifting flakes of organic marine snow provide the primary food source for bizarre creatures of the abyss.
examples.zh: 從海洋表層如雪花般飄落的海雪有機碎屑，是萬米深淵奇特生物賴以維生的主要糧食來源。

examples.en: Composed of dead plankton, fecal pellets, and dust, marine snow drifts perpetually into the abyss.
examples.zh: 由死去的浮游生物殘骸、排泄物顆粒與大氣微塵組成的海雪，永不停歇地向萬米深淵深處緩緩沉降。

examples.en: Deep-sea filter feeders extend feathery appendages to catch descending particles of marine snow.
examples.zh: 深海底棲濾食性生物伸展出羽毛般的觸手與過濾篩網，在水流中攔截沉降而下的點點海雪顆粒。

explains.en: A group of people can work or play together. A soccer side may have many members. The word can also mean people who share a job.
Friends may form a group for a game. Workers can join for a shared task. Each person has a role.
This word means a group with a shared goal. Players may practice together. A work group can solve a problem.

examples.en: Good teamwork is essential to win this match.
examples.zh: 良好的團隊合作是贏得這場比賽的關鍵。

examples.en: Our sales team achieved record revenue during the past quarter.
examples.zh: 我們的業務團隊在上一季度創下了歷史新高的營業額。

examples.en: Each team member brings distinct skills and creative perspectives.
examples.zh: 每位團隊成員都帶來了獨特的技能與創新的視角。

entries.definition: 火車；列車；訓練；傳遞發條動力至擒縱結構之四輪機械走時輪系

explains.en: A long vehicle moves on tracks. People ride it between cities. It may carry goods too.
A station is where passengers get on. The vehicle has many cars joined together. It can travel quickly across land.
People may take this vehicle to work. It follows metal rails. A driver controls it from the front.

examples.en: The train from Taipei to Kaohsiung is very fast.
examples.zh: 從台北到高雄的火車非常快。

examples.en: We need to train hard to win the championship.
examples.zh: 我們需要努力訓練才能贏得冠軍。

examples.en: Be sure to arrive at the train platform five minutes before departure.
examples.zh: 務必在發車前五分鐘抵達火車月台。

examples.en: The mechanical gear train multiplies rotation speed from the slow mainspring to the fast escape wheel.
examples.zh: 機械「走時齒輪輪系」（Gear Train），將緩慢旋轉的發條盒轉速逐級放大並傳送至高速跳動的擒縱輪。

examples.en: Commuters boarded the sleek electric high-speed train to travel between Taipei and Kaohsiung in ninety minutes.
examples.zh: 趕著上班洽公的商務通勤旅客陸續登上流線型的台灣高鐵列車，短短九十分鐘即可往返台北與高雄。

examples.en: The professional soccer team traveled to the sports academy to train for the continental cup.
examples.zh: 職業足球隊全員飛抵封閉式高原運動基地，展開為期一個月的魔鬼體能集訓以備戰即將開踢的亞洲盃。

explains.en: A tall living plant has a trunk, branches, and leaves. Birds may make a nest in it. It can give shade.
A forest has many of these plants. A person may climb one as a child. Its roots take in water from soil.
This plant can live for many years. Its branches grow above the ground. It may produce fruit or nuts.

examples.en: Banyan trees provide great shade on sunny days.
examples.zh: 榕樹在出太陽的日子提供良好的遮蔭。

examples.en: Planting green trees helps absorb carbon dioxide and cools our cities.
examples.zh: 種植綠樹有助於吸收二氧化碳並為我們的城市降溫。

examples.en: Birds build protective nests among the thick branches of the oak tree.
examples.zh: 鳥兒在橡樹茂密的枝枒間築起遮風避雨的巢穴。

entries.definition: 寬的；廣闊的；充分睜大的。

explains.en: It means having a large distance from left to right. A river can be hard to cross. A road may have many lanes.
A door can have a large opening from side to side. A smile may stretch across a face. The word describes a great width.
This word means broad. A table may have a large surface. It can describe something that covers a lot from one side to another.

examples.en: The river is wide near the bridge.
examples.zh: 河流在橋附近很寬。

examples.en: She opened the wide gate.
examples.zh: 她打開寬大的門。

examples.en: The table is too wide for this room.
examples.zh: 這張桌子對這個房間來說太寬了。

entries.definition: 骨頭；支撐身體的硬組織。

explains.en: The hard parts inside a body support it. A dog has many. A doctor may mend one after a break.
A person’s body has a frame made from these hard parts. They protect organs. Milk helps keep them strong.
A skeleton is made of many hard pieces. A person may break one in a fall. The body can heal it.

examples.en: The dog broke a bone in its leg.
examples.zh: 狗的腿骨斷了。

examples.en: A strong bone supports the body.
examples.zh: 堅硬的骨頭支撐著身體。

examples.en: The puppy buried a bone in the garden.
examples.zh: 小狗把骨頭埋在花園裡。

explains.en: A farm animal has horns and a beard. It eats grass and leaves. Its young is called a kid.
This animal can climb rocky hills. It may give milk. A person may keep one on a farm.
A male or female farm animal has a short tail. It eats plants. Some people make cheese from its milk.

examples.en: Mountain goats can climb extremely steep rocky cliffs.
examples.zh: 野山羊能夠攀爬非常陡峭的岩壁。

examples.en: Fresh goat milk and goat cheese are nutrient-rich dairy options.
examples.zh: 新鮮羊奶與羊乳酪是營養豐富的乳製品選擇。

examples.en: The lively baby goat leaped playfully around the farm enclosure.
examples.zh: 活潑的小山羊在農場圍欄周圍歡快地蹦蹦跳跳。

entries.definition: （名）健行；遠足；（動）徒步旅行；大幅提高。

explains.en: It means walking a long way in nature. A person may carry water and a bag. A mountain path can be steep.
Friends may take a long walk through a forest. They can enjoy views. Good shoes help.
This outdoor activity uses trails. A person may climb a hill. It can take several hours.

examples.en: We went on a hike in the hills.
examples.zh: 我們去山區健行。

examples.en: The hike took three hours.
examples.zh: 這趟健行花了三小時。

examples.en: They hiked along the river trail.
examples.zh: 他們沿著河邊步道健行。

explains.en: This noun describes an unpleasant feeling in the body or mind. A person may feel it after getting hurt or losing something important. It can also be used for a difficult problem.
A scraped knee may hurt when a child bends it. A sad story can cause strong feelings in the heart. People use the word for both physical and emotional discomfort.
An unpleasant feeling can come from an injury or a loss. Not every ache is severe. In polite conversation, people may say they are hurting.

examples.en: He felt pain in his ankle after the race.
examples.zh: 比賽後，他感到腳踝疼痛。

examples.en: The nurse helped ease the pain in her arm.
examples.zh: 護理師幫忙減輕她手臂的疼痛。

examples.en: It caused great pain when the old tree fell.
examples.zh: 老樹倒下時，令人十分難過。

explains.en: This adjective describes behavior that is not polite or kind. It can describe words, actions, or a person’s manner. Speaking over someone may seem this way.
A person may interrupt a friend and refuse to listen. A child can learn to say “please” and “thank you.” Polite words help people get along.
This behavior is stronger than simply being quiet or shy. It often means someone has ignored good manners. A direct comment can sound unkind even if it is true.

examples.en: It is rude to interrupt someone when they speak.
examples.zh: 在別人說話時插嘴是不禮貌的。

examples.en: The waiter received complaints because of his rude attitude.
examples.zh: 那位服務生因為粗魯無禮的態度而遭到投訴。

examples.en: It is rude to stare pointedly at strangers on the subway.
examples.zh: 在捷運上盯著陌生人看是非常不禮貌的。

entries.definition: 橫樑；大樑；光束；殿堂雕花大樑與通樑

explains.en: A long strong piece of wood or metal supports a roof or floor. Builders place it carefully. It carries weight across an open space.
A bright ray of light can come through a window. Dust floats in it. The room looks golden in the morning.
A person may smile broadly with happiness. Friends share good news. Their faces show joy.

examples.en: Heavy reinforced steel beams support the weight of the upper floors.
examples.zh: 沉重的耐震鋼樑穩穩支撐著上層樓地板的全部重量。

examples.en: A single flashlight beam pierced through the pitch-black darkness of the cavern.
examples.zh: 一道耀眼的手電筒光束劃破了幽深溶洞中伸手不見五指的漆黑死寂。

examples.en: She couldn't help but beam with pride as her daughter walked up to receive the diploma.
examples.zh: 看著女兒落落大方步上講台領取畢業證書，她臉上不禁綻放出無比驕傲自豪的笑容。

examples.en: Master carpenters carved auspicious bats and peonies across the solid Hinoki cypress main beam.
examples.zh: 大木作傳統匠師在整根台灣特選檜木大樑上，精雕細琢出象徵福氣的祥蝠與富貴牡丹。

examples.en: Tension steel cables were concealed inside the hollowed core of the historic beam to provide extra load capacity.
examples.zh: 隱藏在高空古樑內部的補強鋼索，在不破壞外觀的前提下提供了額外的結構承重力。

examples.en: Rain leaking through damaged roof tiles had caused superficial dry rot along the northern beam.
examples.zh: 屋瓦破裂滲入的雨水，曾導致朝北通樑表面產生了局部的乾腐病變。

explains.en: A hard piece of rock may lie on a path, beach, or mountain. People can pick up small pieces, but large ones are heavy. A small piece can fit inside a pocket.
Some pieces of rock become smooth from moving in water for a long time. Other pieces have rough edges and should be handled carefully. Water can polish rough edges over many years.
People build walls or houses with cut pieces of rock. Certain kinds are also used to make jewelry or decorations. Careful builders choose pieces that fit together.

examples.en: The path in the park is paved with smooth stones.
examples.zh: 公園裡的小徑鋪著平滑的鵝卵石。

examples.en: Children love skipping stones across the calm river surface.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡在平靜的河面上打水漂石子。

examples.en: The ancient castle was constructed from sturdy gray stone.
examples.zh: 這座古老的城堡是由堅固的灰色岩石建成的。

entries.definition: 火星地下龐大天然火山熔岩洞穴通道；管子

explains.en: A long hollow object carries water, air, or another material from one place to another. A straw is a small example. Pipes can be much larger.
A soft cylinder can hold paint, toothpaste, or cream. People squeeze out a small amount. Closing the cap keeps it clean.
A hollow part can fit inside a machine. Its opening lets something pass through. The size depends on the job it must do.

examples.en: Underground lava tubes span fifty meters wide, providing ready-made caverns shielded from surface micrometeorites.
examples.zh: 火星地下寬達五十公尺的火山熔岩洞穴通道，是隔絕地表微隕石撞擊的現成地下基地。

examples.en: Thermal imaging cameras discovered openings leading into massive subsurface lava tube networks.
examples.zh: 軌道探測器的紅外線熱顯像儀，在火山斜坡邊緣發現了數個直通地下龐大熔岩管網系統的天窗開口。

examples.en: Inflatable habitat modules can be expanded inside a deep lava tube to create a permanent underground settlement.
examples.zh: 將充氣式模組化居住艙運送進深層熔岩洞穴中展開組裝，能建構出不受沙塵暴侵擾的永久性地下城。

entries.definition: 伊莉莎白頸圈；防舔頭套 (Elizabeth Collar)

explains.en: A solid shape has a round base and a pointed top. An ice cream holder is shaped this way. It fits in one hand.
A traffic marker warns drivers to stay away from an area. Bright colors make it easy to see. Workers place it safely.
A pine tree grows hard seed cases with this shape. They hold seeds. Some open when they dry.

examples.en: The dog wore a soft recovery cone to prevent licking surgical stitches.
examples.zh: 狗狗在術後乖乖戴上柔軟舒適的防舔大聲公造型伊莉莎白頭套，以防舔咬腹部縫線。

examples.en: An inflatable protective collar is often more comfortable than a rigid plastic cone.
examples.zh: 充氣式防舔圈甜甜圈比起傳統堅硬的塑膠喇叭頭套而言，往往能讓毛孩感到更為舒適。

examples.en: He bumped into doorframes while getting used to walking around the house with his cone.
examples.zh: 狗狗剛戴上大喇叭頭套在家中四處走動時，還不太習慣轉彎而頻頻撞上兩側門框。

explains.en: This musical instrument is held sideways and played by blowing across an opening. The player presses keys to change the notes. It often makes a clear, high sound.
A student can learn simple songs on this instrument with regular practice. Breath control is important. Cleaning it after playing helps keep it in good condition.
A recorder is held more upright and has a different mouthpiece. Both are wind instruments because the player uses air to make sound. Their tones are not exactly alike.

examples.en: She plays the flute in the school concert band.
examples.zh: 她在學校管樂團裡吹長笛。

examples.en: The clear, sweet notes of the silver flute charmed the audience.
examples.zh: 銀製長笛清脆甜美的音符吸引了在場的觀眾。

examples.en: Learn how to breathe steadily when practicing the flute.
examples.zh: 練習長笛時要學會如何穩定地調節呼吸。

explains.en: To breathe out slowly and audibly is to do this. Someone may do it after finishing a hard task. It can show relief or sadness.
The noun can mean the breath itself. A tired person may let out one after a long walk. The sound is soft.
A gasp is a sudden sharp breath, while this action is slower and longer. People may do it when disappointed. The face and voice give clues.

examples.en: She sighed with relief when the test was over.
examples.zh: 考試結束時，她鬆了一口氣。

examples.en: He sighed after carrying the heavy box upstairs.
examples.zh: 他把沉重的箱子搬上樓後嘆了口氣。

examples.en: A deep sigh came from the tired traveler.
examples.zh: 疲憊的旅人深深嘆了一口氣。

entries.definition: （名）曲調；旋律；（動）調音；調整；收聽。

explains.en: A series of musical notes that form a song is called this. A person may recognize it after hearing just a few notes. It can be hummed.
To adjust a musical instrument or engine so it works well is also described by this verb. A guitar needs its strings adjusted. A mechanic may adjust a car engine.
Lyrics are the words in a song, while this noun refers to the melody. The verb has a different use. Context tells which meaning is intended.

examples.en: I recognized the tune from the movie.
examples.zh: 我認出了這段電影配樂。

examples.en: She tuned her guitar before practice.
examples.zh: 練習前，她調好了吉他的音準。

examples.en: The children sang a familiar tune together.
examples.zh: 孩子們一起唱了一首熟悉的曲子。

entries.definition: （名）立方體；方塊；（動）切成小方塊

explains.en: A solid shape has six equal square sides and sharp corners. A toy block or a small ice piece can have this form. It takes up space in three directions.
The children stacked wooden blocks with equal square faces. They made a tower and counted how many they used. Each block had the same shape.
A flat square has only length and width. A solid block also has height. Shapes help people describe objects.

examples.en: She dropped an ice cube into her lemonade.
examples.zh: 她在檸檬水裡放了一塊冰塊。

examples.en: The toy box contained a red wooden cube.
examples.zh: 玩具箱裡有一個紅色的木立方體。

examples.en: Cut the cheese into small cubes for the salad.
examples.zh: 把起司切成小方塊放進沙拉裡。

explains.en: This adjective means unable or unwilling to speak. A person may choose not to talk during a game. A machine can also have no sound.
As a verb, it means to make something quiet or silent. A button may turn off a phone's sound. A person may also stop another from speaking.
As a noun, it can name the silent button or setting on a device. The exact use depends on the sentence. It relates to the absence of speech or sound.

examples.en: Mute your microphone when you are not speaking in online meetings.
examples.zh: 線上視訊會議未發言時請將麥克風設為靜音。

examples.en: Press the mute button on the TV remote during loud commercials.
examples.zh: 在吵鬧的廣告時段按下電視遙控器上的靜音鍵。

examples.en: He stared in mute shock when hearing the unbelievable news.
examples.zh: 聽到這起令人難以置信的消息時，他震驚得啞口無言。

explains.en: This is a vehicle with two wheels and pedals. A rider pushes the pedals to move it. It can be used for travel or exercise.
People sit on this two-wheeled machine and move the pedals with their feet. It has a handlebar for steering. Many children learn to ride one.
This word names a light vehicle powered by a rider’s legs. It has two wheels and a seat. People use it on roads and paths.

examples.en: Remember to lock your bike when you park it outside.
examples.zh: 將腳踏車停在室外時記得上鎖。

examples.en: Always remember to strap your safety helmet securely before riding your mountain bike.
examples.zh: 在騎乘你的登山腳踏車之前，務必記得將安全帽繫緊扣好。

examples.en: She pedaled her vintage city bike along the tree-lined avenue toward the central market.
examples.zh: 她沿著綠樹成蔭的大道踩著她的復古城市腳踏車前往中央市集。
